_comment: Catalog of optional third-party assets that AmiCachy can fetch on demand. See tools/fetch_asset/. Each asset is downloaded directly from its origin server; AmiCachy does not mirror or redistribute the binaries.

assets.name: AROS Vision (UAE Edition)
assets.summary: Pre-configured AROS 68k Workbench environment by Olaf 'Olsen' Schoenweiss. Bundles AROS ROM replacements (no proprietary Kickstart needed), an enriched Workbench setup, MUI, common applications and a curated WHDLoad library. The UAE Edition is the variant intended for emulators and is the legally cleanest one — it does not require a proprietary Kickstart 3.1 ROM.
assets.license_summary: AROS core is licensed under the AROS Public License (APL). The bundle includes third-party software (MUI, WHDLoad slaves, applications) under their respective freeware/shareware terms — see the homepage for full conditions. AmiCachy does not redistribute the archive: it is fetched directly from the author's server with your explicit consent.

install._comment: Hardware values mirror the upstream UAE_config.uae shipped inside the bundle, minus the RTG card. The 'Picasso96 + dir-mount' combination triggers a horizontal-tiling bug in Amiberry/cage that paints the framebuffer twice side by side; HDF + RTG is fine, but this bundle is a deployed filesystem so we run it on chipset AGA instead. Note the upstream config used a Vampire/Apollo profile (68040+68060) — we use plain 68020 to avoid the bundle's Startup-Sequence taking the Apollo branch (vcontrol/apoke).
